validation.notes: Repaired two production files. (1) packages/coding-agent/src/utils/text.ts: stripBom was a no-op, so BOM-prefixed oauth.json/settings.json failed JSON.parse inside migrations' silent catch blocks and credentials disappeared; stripBom now returns splitBom(content).text, removing exactly one leading U+FEFF while plain and interior-BOM text pass through unchanged, which also fixes every other stripBom consumer (frontmatter, settings-manager, themes, auth-storage). (2) packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the settings.json apiKeys fallback now skips providers already migrated from oauth.json (!Object.hasOwn(migrated, provider)), so OAuth wins over a same-provider API key and each provider is reported once; unrelated settings are retained, oauth.json is archived to oauth.json.migrated only after a successful parse, malformed oauth.json/settings.json keep their bytes, and a pre-existing auth.json short-circuits before any legacy file is read, archived or rewritten. .prale-eval/regression.mjs links the real text.ts, frontmatter.ts and migrations.ts through createGraph from .prale-eval/subject.mjs, faking only boundaries (chalk, yaml, ./config.ts, ./core/keybindings.ts) and exercising the real fs builtin on throwaway directories under .prale-eval/ that are removed on exit; it asserts cross-module behaviour with uncaught node:assert/strict assertions (BOM-aware stripBom/splitBom semantics, BOM-prefixed frontmatter parsing, and the full oauth.json+settings.json -> auth.json merge). Mutation check: restoring utils/text.ts alone to its faulty baseline fails with AssertionError (no auth.json produced from BOM input, plus direct stripBom mismatch); restoring migrations.ts alone fails with AssertionError (duplicate 'anthropic' provider and the API key overwriting the OAuth credential). Both are assertion failures, not crashes or import errors. Limitation: the workspace has no node_modules, so tsc --noEmit, biome and vitest were unavailable and no dependencies were installed; the VM-module regression script is the validation evidence.
